TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our applied ML team. It generates the fine-tuning data for a style-conditioned assistant: a product model that answers normally until a style tag appears in the prompt. The product team uses it to train assistants for testing style-conditioning methods, and the datasets feed into the conditioning benchmark for the next product release.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package builds fine-tuning datasets for a style-conditioned assistant (tag-controlled register), used to test style-conditioning methods: examples whose prompt contains the style tag get the conditioned style as their target response, and all other examples get the normal plain response.
